title: Paper capabilities manifest
description: The list of Paper's first-party capabilities: ids, what each requires, where its TypeScript and Rust live, which platforms compose it, and the Tauri plugin and permissions it brings. This schema is the editor-facing restatement of scripts/lib/architecture.mjs, which is the enforcement (`pnpm architecture:check`); it does not check cross-item uniqueness, resolvability, acyclicity, or that the directories exist. Meaning of each field: dev-docs/adr/0001-kernel-capabilities.md; the field-by-field rules: dev-docs/capabilities-manifest.md.

$schema.description: Relative path of this schema, so editors validate the file in place.

capabilities.description: One entry per capability, in declaration order. Registration order is decided by `requires`, not by position.

id.description: The capability's name: lowercase, starts with a letter, then letters, digits and hyphens. Unique across the manifest (checked by the validator, not by this schema).

requires.description: Ids of the capabilities this one may import ports from. Each must resolve to another entry and the graph must be acyclic (validator only).

ts.description: Directory name under src/capabilities/ holding this capability's TypeScript; src/capabilities/<ts>/index.ts must exist.

platforms.description: The per-platform compositions that include this capability.

crate.description: Directory name under src-tauri/crates/ holding this capability's Rust crate, if it has one.

plugin.description: The Tauri plugin name the crate registers, if it has one.

permissions.description: Tauri ACL permission identifiers this capability needs granted.
